original of the photograph had been taken into custody

1.40 p.m.-3.30 p.m. Kinnear Road,

Shanghai Municipal Police, visited Bubbling Well Police
Station and reported that he had observed a number of
armed men in plain clothes walking East to West along
Kinnear Road.

men promptly proceeded to the place mentioned.

From enquiries conducted by D.I. Tebrun and P.S.I.
Yao Suen Loong at the scene it was said by bystanders
that the armed party constituted the bodyguards of one
Mr. Sun ( )(the conductor of the China Club,
29 Nanking Road) whom they were escorting along Kinnear
Road to 76 Jessfield Road.

The above mentioned two detectives later visited
the Headquarters of the Special Service Corps of the
Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern & National Salvation
Army, 76 Jessfield Road, in connection with another
matter and learned from Woo S Pau and Ma Siau Tien,
executives of this organization, that the armed party
referred to above had been despatched by them to search
premises located off Kinnear Road in S.C.G.P.B. territory
The object of the search was not revealed.

1.

SUSPECTED ARMED HIGHWAY ROBBERY ON BRENNAN ROAD, OOL.
At 12.40 a.m. 31-1-40, one Foo Seu Wah (胡善華)
chauffeur No.134 of Silver Taxi Co., (Driving Permit
No. 17549), reported that at 11.30 p.m. 30-1-40, he
answered a call, driving car Lic.No.18266, from the
Avenue Rd. Silver Taxi Station to the Nyi Wa (藝華)
Motion Picture Co., Connaught Road. When he arrived
there five men came out of the premises and boarded his
car. They told him to drive to Jesfield Park and when
his car arrived at Brennan Road, about 200 yards south
of Jesfield Brennan Piece, four men, all dressed in
Chinese short jacket and pants, stood in the road and
barred his way. One of them had a torch which he shone
in the drivers face and waved the car to a standstill.
The driver stopped his car and one of the men
approached the car and it was seen he had a small
black pistol in his hand. He opened the door of the
car and told the five men to alight. They did so and
the three other men searched them. When they had
concluded their search they told the passengers to get
back into the car. Whilst they were doing so, several
persons passed by the car and the robbers appeared to
become alarmed and walked away.
The passengers told the chauffeur to drive on to
Jesfield Park, which he did.

“B”区
杂项档案号 68/40。    静安寺
                   1940年1月31日。
1.

外滩越界筑路区布伦南路疑似武装拦路抢劫案。
1940年1月31日凌晨12:40，银色出租车公司第134号司机胡善華（Foo Seu Wah）（驾驶执照号 17549）报告称，1940年1月30日晚上11:30，他响应呼叫，驾驶车牌号为18266的汽车，从爱文义路银色出租车站前往康纳路艺华影业公司（Nyi Wa Motion Picture Co.）。当他到达那里时，五名男子从 premises 走出并登上他的车。他们让他开车去兆丰公园（Jesfield Park），当他的车到达布伦南路（Brennan Road），即在兆丰布伦段（Jesfield Brennan Piece，音译）以南约200码处时，四名男子，均身穿中式短褂和裤子，站在路中间拦住去路。其中一人手持手电筒，照向司机面部，并挥手示意停车。司机停下车，其中一名男子走近车辆，可见他手中持有一把小型黑色手枪。他打开车门，命令那五名男子下车。他们照做了，另外三名男子对他们进行了搜身。搜身结束后，他们让乘客回到车上。就在他们这样做的时候，有几个人从车旁经过，劫匪似乎变得惊慌，随即走开。
乘客告诉司机继续开往兆丰公园，司机照办了。

pages.en:
Misc.No.63/40.
1/2.

Arriving at the Jessfield Park, they told the
car to stop and one of the passengers alighted. The
remaining four told the chauffeur to drive to 8te.
F. Destelen, and on arrival there a second passenger
alighted. The chauffeur was then told to drive to
Rue Prelupt where the remaining three left the car.
The chauffeur cannot say whether anything was
stolen or give any useful description of the culprits,
apart from the fact they spoke Kiangsu dialect.
The passengers did not appear to be unduly
disturbed by their experience and advised the chauffeur
not to bother to report the matter to the station.

Sen. Det.
D.D.C."B" Div.

W. A. Young
C. S. I.

到达兆丰公园后，他们让车停下，其中一名乘客下车。剩下的四人告诉司机开往德斯蒂伦神父路（Rue St. F. Destelen，音译），到达那里后，第二名乘客下车。随后司机被告知开往普鲁路（Rue Prelupt，音译），剩下的三人在那里下了车。
除了他们会讲江苏方言这一事实外，司机无法说明是否有物品被盗，也无法提供罪犯的任何有用描述。
乘客们似乎并未因这次经历而感到过度不安，并建议司机不必费心向捕房报告此事。

1.

Report on Shooting Affray.
S.C.G.P.B.

At 9.50p.m. 6/3/40, a telephone message was received
at the station reporting that a shooting affray had taken
place on Jessfield Road near Connaught Road.

A party of police under S.T. Daintery attended.

Enquiries made by D.S. Meeks, D.C.I. Yao Yuen Loong
and C.D.C. 147 ascertained that at about 9.40p.m. 6/3/40,
a plain-clothes search party, believed to be from 76
Jessfield Road, were operating in lane 119 Jessfield Road
(Chinese No. 776), when they encountered three male
Chinese, who on being challenged, opened fire on the
search party, who turned the fire.

No person was injured, but one male Chinese was
arrested.

The S.M. Police party made a search on the roadway
and succeeded in finding two misfire 7.65 cartridges, two
7.65 cartridge cases and two .380 cartridge cases. These
are being forwarded to the A.I.S. for examination.

Enquiries at the S.C.G.P.B. Headquarters, 13 Jess-
field Road revealed that they were unable to supply the
arrested man's name and address etc., as he had been
taken to 76 Jessfield Road.

Forwarded for information.

Sen.Det./C.
D. S. 252.

关于枪击冲突的报告。
苏州河以北公共租界捕房辖区（S.C.G.P.B.）。

1940年3月6日晚上9:50，捕房接到电话报告，称极司菲尔路靠近康纳路处发生了一起枪击冲突。

由丹特里（Daintery，音译）警佐率领的一队警察前往处理。

经米克斯（Meeks，音译）副侦探、姚元龙（Yao Yuen Loong，音译）副巡官和第147号华人侦探长调查查明，1940年3月6日晚上9:40左右，一支便衣搜索队（据信来自极司菲尔路76号）正在极司菲尔路119弄（中文门牌776号）行动，此时他们遭遇了三名中国男子，这些人在受到盘查时向搜索队开火，搜索队予以还击。

无人受伤，但一名中国男子被捕。

工部局警务队对路面进行了搜查，成功发现两枚哑火的7.65毫米子弹、两个7.65毫米弹壳和两个.380口径弹壳。这些物证正送交助理法医检验师（A.I.S.）进行检验。

在极司菲尔路13号的苏州河以北公共租界捕房总部进行的查询显示，他们无法提供被捕者的姓名和地址等信息，因为他已被带至极司菲尔路76号。

呈报供参考。

高级侦探/主管。
D. S. 252。

Subject Assistance to French Police.
Made by D. S. I. Black Forwarded by Officer i/c.
AC (3/Branch)
Sir,
Information
At 3.54 a.m. 9/2/40 a telephone message was received from C.P.C. 1176 of the French Police stating that he was detaining a motor car at Weihaiwei and Mohawk Roads corner. P.S. Egberg attended and brought both chauffeur and Policeman to the Station.
Enquiries in the Charge-Room showed that motor car license No. 1375 driven by Yao Ts Hyi (姚智喜) License no. 1135 of 76 Jessfield Road was challenged by C.P.C. 1176 while travelling East to West on Ave. Ed. VII. It failed to stop immediately, the French C.P.C. blew his whistle and gave chase and the car stopped on Racecourse Road outside the Racecourse Apartments. The French C.P.C. then boarded the car and told the chauffeur to drive to Poste Mallet, instead of which he drove to Mohawk and Weihaiwei Roads corner and appealed to the guard at the Seaforth Highlanders' billets, it was from there that the phone call was made.
Chauffeur handed over to the French Police at 4.35 a.m. 9/2/40 on instructions of D.O. "A" Div.
The motor car was taken away at 8.30 a.m. 9/2/40 from Weihaiwei and Mohawk Roads corner by the French Police.
Sen. Det. i/c.

情报
1940年2月9日凌晨3:54，接到法国警察第1176号中央巡逻车（C.P.C.）的电话，称他在威海卫路和莫霍克路（Mohawk Roads，音译）拐角处扣留了一辆汽车。警士埃格伯格（Egberg，音译）前往处理，并将司机和警察带回捕房。
拘留室的查询显示，车牌号1375的汽车由极司菲尔路76号的姚智喜（Yao Ts Hyi，音译）（执照号1135）驾驶，在沿爱德华七世大道（Ave. Ed. VII）由东向西行驶时，受到法国警察第1176号中央巡逻车的盘查。该车未立即停车，法国中央巡逻车警员吹响哨子并追赶，该车停在跑马厅公寓外的跑马厅路（Racecourse Road）。法国中央巡逻车警员随后上车，命令司机开往马勒岗哨（Poste Mallet，音译），但司机却开到了莫霍克路和威海卫路的拐角处，并向西福斯高地团（Seaforth Highlanders）营房的守卫求助，电话就是从那里打出的。
根据“A”区总监的指示，司机于1940年2月9日凌晨4:35移交给法国警察。
该汽车于1940年2月9日上午8:30由法国警察从威海卫路和莫霍克路拐角处带走。
主管高级侦探。
“A”区副助理总监

REPORT
Date: 3rd January, 1940.
Subject. Information - execution & detention of members of the special service corps of the Chung wo Kuomintang & National Salvation Army.
Made by. Det. Inspector Abram. Forwarded by. J.S. Farlane /Inspector i/c.

It is reported that on 20 Dec (王永發 alias Sai Fah or 亡百章) was shot and killed on Bubbling Well Road a few days ago on the instigation of Wang and his co-conspirator Tsoo Tsui (夏越) was taken into custody, and is now being held as prisoner at 7C.

It appears from information at hand that Wong Foon Fat entered a shop in the Bubbling Well area and as he was not recognized by the shop assistant and denied the privilege of purchasing commodities at a special rate he called about 10 of his armed followers from the Han Yang (韓飞) Primary School to kidnap the proprietor of the shop.

One Wong Foon Fat was formerly the principal in charge of the Bubbling Well branch of the special service corps of the Chung Wo Kuomintang & National Salvation Army, and Tsoo Tsui (夏越) up to the time of his arrest was the principal of the sub branch of the special service corps of the Chung Wo Kuomintang & National Salvation Army established at the Han Yang Primary School, Lowu Road, etc.

R. J. Abram

日期：1940年1月3日。
主题。情报 - 中国国民党与救国军特别服务队成员的处决及拘留。
由 巡官艾布拉姆（Abram）呈报。转呈由 J.S. Farlane /主管督察。

据报，王永发（别名 Sai Fah 或 亡百章）于几天前在静安寺路被枪杀，此举系受汪某及其同谋夏越（Tsoo Tsui，音译）指使。夏越已被拘留，目前作为囚犯关押在7C（原文如此，可能指极司菲尔路76号或其他代号）。

根据现有情报，黄福发（Wong Foon Fat，即王永发）进入静安寺地区的一家商店，由于店员不认识他，并拒绝给予其以特价购买商品的特权，他从汉阳（Han Yang，音译）小学召集了约10名武装追随者，绑架了该店店主。

黄福发曾任中国国民党与救国军特别服务队静安寺分队的负责人，而夏越（Tsoo Tsui，音译）在被捕前一直担任设在罗浮路（Lowu Road，音译）等地汉阳小学的中国国民党与救国军特别服务队支队的负责人。

R. J. Abram

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Informant Lee Yoong Dung (李榮東).
native of Siausan in Chekiang. taken by C.D.S. 159.
at Gnd. Stn. on the 14/12/39. and translated by Clerk, Tung Yih Hsiang.

My name is Lee Yoong Dung, age 33 years, native of
Siausan in the province of Chekiang, residing at and employed
as a manager by the "Yoh Sing Silk Filature" situated at Lane
984/90 Changping Road.

At about 6 p.m. on the 13th inst. there came to my filature more
than 10 persons (including one Japanese and one uniformed
constable) under the pretext of being in search of CONTRABAND
Narcotics. On entering the accountant
office, the Japanese said in his language which was later
interpreted by one Chinese man it was reported by somebody
to the effect that our factory concealed a quantity of
CONTRABAND Narcotics and that we should be taken to their headquarters
for enquiries.

The plain-clothes guided by the Japanese, ordered me to go
first, then Hoong in his car they themselves walked behind
sticking to us. On arrival at Singapore Road, we observed
a waiting motor car No. unknown which, upon our riding,
was driven in a westerly direction and took us straight to a
certain organization in Zau Ka Doo. No uniformed men but
plain-clothes one were found in that organization. I do
not know what the organization is called. We were detained
there for three days and every day somebody came to me asking
me how many masters there were in our factory and what their
names were. In reply I told them that there were many masters
in our factory but all of them were in country and not in
Shanghai. I further told them that I was a manager of the

本人名为李荣东，现年33岁，籍贯浙江省萧山县，现居住并受雇于昌平路984弄90号“越兴丝厂”（Yoh Sing Silk Filature），担任经理职务。

本月13日下午6时许，有十余人（包括一名日本人及一名身着制服的巡捕）以搜查违禁毒品为借口来到本丝厂。进入会计室后，该日本人用其本国语言说话，后由一名华人翻译，称有人举报本厂藏有大量违禁毒品，并称应将我们带往其总部进行讯问。

在该日本人指挥下的便衣人员命令我先走，随后洪某（Hoong，音译）乘坐他们的汽车，他们自己则步行紧随其后。抵达新加坡路时，我们看到一辆等候的汽车，车牌号不详，我们上车后，该车向西行驶，直接将我们带至曹家渡（Zau Ka Doo）的某组织。该组织内未见身着制服者，仅有便衣人员。本人不知该组织名称。我们被拘禁于此三日，每日均有人前来询问本厂有多少位老板及其姓名。我回答说本厂老板众多，但均在乡下，不在上海。我还告诉他们，我是本厂的

Sir,
At 10 a.m. December 9, 1939, Sung Yih Ching
(沈一青) employee of the Yui Shing (越兴) Silk
Factory, Lane 984 House 90 Changping Road came to
station and reported that at about 8 a.m. that morning
about eleven or twelve persons, one of whom was believed
to speak Japanese, one other dressed in S.C.G.P.Bureau
uniform and four or five plainclothes men armed with
pistols (hammers), entered the office of the factory
and demanded to see the "Lau Pei". Informant, who was
approached, informed them that the owner did not stay
at the mill, whereupon some of the gang kicked him and
then entered the accountant's office. There they found
the factory manager Lee Yong Dong (李荣棠), 33, Zao-
shing, married and residing on the premises and the
accountant Ong Wo Gee (洪立其), 50, Zeushing, Single
and residing in the factory. Both men were roughly
"arrested" and pushed out of the factory by several of
the gang whilst others warned the remainder of the
office staff to remain indoors. Later when informant
made a move he was unable to find out from persons in
the vicinity in which direction the two employees had
been taken or how. Sung Yih Ching then reported to
Gordon Road Station where he produced S.M.C. Revenue
Office Tax receipt dated October 1939 to prove taxes
are being paid the S.M.C. The premises however, are
situated in an open lane therefore S.C.G.P.B. jurisdic-
tion.

1939年12月9日上午10时，昌平路984弄90号越兴（Yui Shing，越兴）丝厂雇员沈一青（Sung Yih Ching）来到捕房报案称，当日早晨8时许，约十一或十二人，其中一人被认为讲日语，另一人身着苏州河以北捕房制服，另有四五名便衣男子持手枪（击锤），进入工厂办公室，要求见“老板”。报案人上前告知他们厂主不住在厂内，随即这伙人中有人踢打报案人，并进入会计室。在那里，他们发现了工厂经理李荣棠（Lee Yong Dong，李荣棠），33岁，浙江绍兴人，已婚，居住在厂内；以及会计师洪立其（Ong Wo Gee，洪立其），50岁，浙江绍兴人，未婚，居住在厂内。两人被这伙人中的几名粗暴地“逮捕”并推出工厂，其他人则警告其余办公室职员留在室内。后来当报案人试图行动时，无法从附近人士处得知这两名员工被带往何方或以何种方式带走。沈一青随后向戈登路捕房报案，并出示了1939年10月的工部局税务局税单，以证明已向工部局缴纳税款。然而，该处所位于一条开放式的弄堂内，因此属于苏州河以北捕房管辖范围。

以下事实：约一个月前，上海特别市政府当局曾就税收事宜接触工厂管理层，但他无法说明税款是否已缴纳。
怀疑上述当局参与了此事，日本宪兵队特务警察第738号辻（Tsuji）走访了杰斯菲尔德路13号和92号，但未能获得有关此案的任何有用信息。
在工厂及周边进行的查询从工厂看守葛新成（Kuo Sing Tsung，葛新成，扬州人）处获悉，他曾在康纳路（Connaught Road）的日本领事馆警察署（J.C.G.Police Station）亲自查询，对方否认实施了逮捕，但一名警察告诉他，这些人可能被带往新加坡路附近的顺禄村22号（Shun Loh Tsun，近大康纱厂对面）。
据信新加坡路顺禄村22号的居住者为直接隶属于汪精卫先生的“自卫团”，但在本案中其具体职能尚不清楚。
特务警察辻报告称，日本宪兵队通常不直接与该股接触。
鉴于认为两名被“逮捕”的男子仅被带走问话，故未立即提交报告。但1939年12月10日对昌平路984弄90号工厂的进一步调查发现，这两人仍然失踪。
侦探们正与报案人沈银清（Sung Yin Ching，音译，越兴工厂采购部职员）保持联系。
此致，
敬礼，
J. Cady

It is reported that a Labour Union designated as the
"Factory & Merchants Union, Shanghai West" (滬西廠商聯合會),
has been established at 191 Yah S Loong, Ferry Road, O.O.L.
The principal is one named Lee Hui Sung (李惠陞),

were seized by members of the S.C.G.P. Bureau on December
1, 1939, when these officers visited the premises for
investigation purposes.

Det. Inspector

“中国巡捕长1428号报告称，1939年12月9日晚8时30分许，他在新加坡路靠近公大纱厂处负责第6搜索队，由西向东行走时，注意到约有八九名武装便衣男子从相反方向走来。
晚上10时，当搜索队再次在同一纱厂附近的新加坡路上向东行进时，四名手持毛瑟手枪的便衣男子超过了他们，另有三人，随后跟着约十名同样身着便衣且携带武器的人，走在他们队伍后面。中国巡捕长命令其队员进入阴影处并准备应对麻烦，但上述人员未发一言便通过了。经查询，中国巡捕长得知他们是新成立的‘自卫局’成员，其搜索队中的几名队员认出其中一些人是他们曾见过穿着苏州河以北捕局制服执行交通勤务的人员。”

（签名） J.M. Watson,
督察，
主管警官。

Sir:
As a result of the shooting affray on Jessfield Road
on the 22-10-39, it is reported that premises No.1081
Jessfield Road from where the shooting at the Police was
directed have been vacated by the occupants who were
members of the Special Service Section.
Of the men taken away by the Japanese Military Police
on the 22-10-39, 11 are detained at the Japanese Naval
Barracks, Kiangwan Road, for enquiries whilst 10 other
members of this group are now serving under Li Shih Chun
at No.76 Jessfield Road and the remainder are at the Civic
Centre receiving training.

Sir,

Information has been obtained that a branch
of the Social Service Corps is being organized in the
Zuh Wei Yao District, off Ferry Road, O.J.L. The branch
intends to occupy a country style house, owned by one
named Dao Ah Ngauh (陶阿牛) alias Dao Mau Mau
(陶毛毛), situated in the above district.

It is intended to recruit a total number of
sixty persons, some forty having already joined. At present
they are stated to be in possession of four pistols, two
of which are mausers, and handgrenades. Any member who
joins and provides his own pistol will be paid $40.00 per
month, while others will receive $20.00 per month.

As far as can be ascertained, the following
is a list of the members:-

4. Assistant Group Leader - Mau Kuo Sung (毛國生).

              Woo Zang Meu (吳長茂).

1939年10月23日晚上10点25分，上述印捕将另外两名中国男性施志清（Sze Tse Tsing），26岁，崇明人；沈兆良（Sung Zau Liang），20岁，崇明人，带至巡捕房，两人均居住于爱丁堡路35号。

印捕称，在上述地点执勤时，观察到上述骑自行车的中国人在极司菲尔路上来回骑行。由于他们的行为显得非常可疑，且他们声称因上述协会关系在该区域巡逻，故将他们带至巡捕房作进一步讯问。

经搜查，确认这些人未携带武器。

经副督察长蒂尔（Till）、印度侦探警长273号、印度侦探警员279号和314号讯问，查明以下情况：-

这些人称他们受雇于上述协会（极司菲尔路76号），但隶属于位于爱丁堡路35号的一个分部，该分部由

They were part of a contingent of 60 male Chinese,
who resided on the premises, a number of whom were armed
with Mauser and small pistols (approximately 16). Only

All members had been recruited during the past
few months after their antecedents had been carefully

with a blue cotton cloth uniforms,fashioned on the style
of Dr. Sun Yat Sen.
The monthly salary of the members ranged from
$30.00 to $75.0 , according to ability and length of
service.
The patrol duties were commenced on the 21/10 39,
and all unarmed members were allocated to various beats
in the vicinity of 76 Jessfield Road. In this respect
the arrested members were on bicycle patrol duty between
35 Edinburgh Road, Kinnear Road and Jessfield and Tifen
Road. Their hours of duty consisted of 3 hour shifts,
between 6 a.m. to 12 m.n. When arrested they were on
duty from 9 p.m. to 12 m.n.
During their off duty periods, no members were
allowed to leave the premises, food being supplied on

一名叫李邦安（Lee Pang An）的人指挥。
他们是60名中国男性分队的一部分，这些人居住在 premises 内，其中许多人配备有毛瑟手枪和小口径手枪（约16支）。只有未携带武器的人员参与巡逻工作，其余武装人员则 confined 在 premises 内执行警卫任务。

成员的月薪根据能力和服役年限，从30.00美元到75.0美元不等。
巡逻任务于1939年10月21日开始，所有未携带武器的成员被分配至极司菲尔路76号附近的不同巡逻段。在此方面，被捕成员正在爱丁堡路35号、金尼尔路以及极司菲尔路和地丰路之间进行自行车巡逻。他们的执勤时间为早上6点至午夜12点，每班3小时。被捕时，他们正在执行晚上9点至午夜12点的勤务。
在休班期间，任何成员不得离开 premises，食物供应按

a monthly payment of $10.00.
The object of these patrols were to observe the
movements of any suspicious persons or any unusual
occurrence. Upon such person s being detected, two were
instructed to keep the person/s in sight, whilst the
other immediately reported the matter to 35 Edinburgh
Road.
Upon receipt of the information a small detachment
would be dispatched and the suspicious person/s would be
arrested and taken to 35 Edinburgh Road for enquiries.
The arrested men were finger printed, but investi-
gation showed that all had no previous record.
Mr. Tabrum, A.D.D.C. "B" was informed who attended
the station. After being acquainted with all particulars,
he gave instructions that the men be released. Acting
accordingly, they were allowed to go at 12 m.n.

2.

ILLEGAL FUNCTIONING OF THE "SELF DEFENSE CORPS"

At 7.20 p.m. 19/10/39 a telephone message was
received from Tsih Lien Liang (戚善良) reporting that
his father had returned home.

The undersigned accompanied by C.D.S.167 proceeded
to 84 Edinburgh Road and interviewed Tsih Lai Kung who
stated that he had been kept all the time at 21 Mei Hwa
Li, Zau Ke Yih, where the members of the "Self Defense
Corps" handcuffed him and by beating him continuously
tried to force him to agree to pay compensation to Sung
Zung Fah, who was also present there.

When their attempts failed they told Tsih Lai Kung
that he could be released on payment of "fine" in the sum
of $600.00 or producing a guarantee that the above "fine"
would be paid in the nearest future. Being unable to
stand the torture, Tsih Lai Kung agreed to pay the "fine"
and produced a guarantor, after which he was released at
about 7 p.m. 19/10/39.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

“自卫团”的非法活动

1939年10月19日下午7时20分，接到戚善良（Tsih Lien Liang）的电话报告，称其父亲已回家。

签署人偕同刑事侦缉警员167号前往爱丁堡路84号，讯问了戚来根（Tsih Lai Kung），他陈述说，他一直都被关在曹家堰（Zau Ke Yih）美华里21号，在那里，“自卫团”成员给他戴上手铐，并通过持续殴打，试图强迫他同意赔偿当时也在场的孙顺福（Sung Zung Fah）。

当他们的企图失败后，他们告诉戚来根，他可以缴纳600.00美元的“罚款”，或者提供担保人保证在近期支付上述“罚款”，以此获得释放。戚来根因无法忍受酷刑，同意支付“罚款”并找了一名担保人，随后于1939年10月19日晚7点左右被释放。

1.

ILLEGAL FUNCTIONING OF THE "SELF DEFENSE CORPS"

At 11.40 a.m. 19/10/39 Tsih Zien Liang (戚善良)
of 84/86 Edinburgh Road, C.C.L., reported to the Central
Station that his father Tsih Lai Kung (戚来根), 57,
Ningpo, building contractor, had been abducted by several
armed men from the above address at about 9.30 a.m. even
date. As the alleged offence was committed in this
district, the complt. was sent with C.D.S.185 to this
station.

Further enquiries have been made by D.S.I.
Golenbkoff, D.S.I. Yao Yuen Loong and C.D.S.167 and
the following facts were ascertained:-

Tsih Lai Kung about 2 months ago signed a contract
with the Topas Land Investment, 102 Central Arcade for
the construction of a block of houses in the French
Concession. Previously this contract was in the hands
of a contractor Sung Zung Foh (孫順福), but was with-
drawn by the Topas Land Investment Co., owing to unsatis-
factory work, and given to Tsih Lai Kung. Sung Zung
Foh was very much irritated and blamed Tsih Lai Kung
for the loss of the contract. He anticipated a profit
of about $50,000.00 and lately approached Tsih Lai Kung
and demanded from him the sum of $20,000.00 as compensa-
tion. Tsih Lai Kung refused to pay any compensation, as
according to the contract all claims of Sung Zung Foh
pages.zh:
" B "

                        1939年10月19日。
1.

“自卫团”的非法活动

1939年10月19日上午11时40分，住在中央捕房辖区爱丁堡路84/86号的戚善良（Tsih Zien Liang）向中央捕房报案，称其父戚来根（Tsih Lai Kung），57岁，宁波人，建筑承包商，于同日早上约9时30分在上述地址被几名持枪男子绑架。由于涉嫌犯罪发生在本辖区，投诉人由刑事侦缉警员185号陪同送至本捕房。

经侦探副督察 Golenbkoff、侦探副督察姚元龙（Yao Yuen Loong）及刑事侦缉警员167号进一步调查，查明以下事实：

大约两个月前，戚来根与法租界中央商场102号的 Topas 地产投资公司签订了一份合同，承建该地的一排房屋。此前，该合同由承包商孙顺福（Sung Zung Foh）持有，但因工程不合格，被 Topas 地产投资公司收回并转交给戚来根。孙顺福对此极为恼火，指责戚来根导致其失去合同。他预计利润约为50,000.00美元，最近找到戚来根，要求赔偿20,000.00美元。戚来根拒绝支付任何赔偿，因为根据合同，孙顺福的所有索赔

pages.en:
Miss.No.583/39

1/2.

were to be addressed to the Topas Land Investment Co.,
Sung Zung Poh, however, pressed his demands against
Tsih Lai Kung and recently threatened to cause harm to
the last named.
At about 9.30 a.m. 19/10/39, Tsih Lai Kung was in
his room at 84 Edinburgh Road when suddenly 6 or 7 men
in plain clothes entered the house via open door, four
of them produced pistols and ordered Tsih Lai Kung to
accompany them.
They led him to the road where they called a
private ricksha No. 2915, pulled by coolie Zung Ah
Poh (陳阿福), badge No.4240, which was waiting nearby
for his passenger and placed the victim on the footboard
whilst one of the armed men sat in the ricksha. Then the
above coolie was ordered to pull the ricksha south along
Edinburgh Road, the other men following them on foot.
When the party was near Lucern Road, the victim
began to shout for help, whereupon the armed men pulled
him off the ricksha and forced to walk with them, whilst
the ricksha was ordered to go away.
At about 12 noon a male Chinese riding a bicycle
arrived at the victim's home and stated that Tsih Lai
Kung was detained at the office of the 7th company of
the "Self Defense Corps" in zau ka yih (曹家堰) village
off Edinburgh Road. (This organization forms the subject
pages.zh:
杂项编号 583/39

1/2.

应向 Topas 地产投资公司提出。然而，孙顺福坚持向戚来根索要，并最近威胁要对后者造成伤害。
1939年10月19日上午9时30分左右，戚来根正在爱丁堡路84号的房间内，突然有6或7名便衣男子通过敞开的门进入屋内，其中四人亮出手枪，命令戚来根随他们走。
他们将他带到路上，叫了一辆由车夫陈阿福（Zung Ah Poh，徽章号4240）拉着的私人人力车（第2915号），该车正停在附近等候乘客。他们将受害者放在踏板上，其中一名持枪男子坐在人力车上。随后，上述车夫奉命沿爱丁堡路向南拉车，其他人则步行跟随。
当这群人靠近卢森路（Lucern Road）时，受害者开始呼救，持枪男子便将他从人力车上拽下，强迫他步行跟随，同时命令人力车离开。
中午12点左右，一名骑自行车的中国男子来到受害者家中，称戚来根被关押在爱丁堡路外曹家堰（zau ka yih）村“自卫团”第七连的办公室。（该组织是高级探长主管 B.W. 于1939年8月29日提交的情报报告的主题

pages.en:
Miss.No.583/32

1/3.

of the information report forwarded by Sen. Det. i/c.
B.W. on 29/8/39). The messenger said that Tsih Lai Kung
requested the documents relating to the contract to be
sent to him, and produced Tsih LAI KUNG's card on which
the latter wrote himself a message to his family. The
photographs of the documents were sent by the victim's
son in law with their servant Lee Hoong Tsing (李鴻清)
who accompanied the messenger. The servant was led to
house No. 21, Mei Hwa Li (美華里), Zau Ka Yih off Edin-
burgh Road, where he saw Tsih Lai Kung surrounded by a
large number of the members of the "Self Defense Corps".
The photographs were taken from the servant and he was
ordered to return home.

The houses Nos. 84 & 86 Edinburgh Road are situated
in the lane known as Moon Villa, about 40 yards off Edin-
burgh Road and S.M.C. taxes are being paid by the occu-
pants.

Informed D.O. "B".

Sir;

Jessfield Road, from the landlords, Mutual Investment

etc., at 4 p.m. Monday, Oct. 2, 1939.

at the time and place appointed, no deal was made and
the Theosophical Society are still in possession of 75

Sir,
Further to information report dated 5/9/39
it is now understood that the number of men residing
in the Kan Kue (韓公) Primary School, No. 1500
Brenan Road have been increased to 250 they style
themselves as the Special Services Section.
A female named Tsang Pah Mei (張八妹)
formerly leader of a guerrilla band in Nootung and
Sungkiang is now in charge of these men whilst Woo Tsaung
(夏超) is her assistant.
Information obtained is that these persons are
responsible for the recent murders and that some 30 other
murders are to be committed mostly on school principals
who do not teach the young Chiang Kai (汪精衛) doctrines
These men receive a salary of $40.00 per month
and for each murder committed by them they receive a bonus
of at least $600.00 and expenses.
Since the arrival of Tsang Pah Mei (張八妹),
these persons work on behalf of the Japanese independent
of Lee Shih Chun (李自羣), who has no control over
them.

D. S. I.
D.D.O "B" Div.

一名名为张八妹（Tsang Pah Mei）的女子，曾是南通和松江一带游击队的头目，现在负责管理这些人，夏超（Woo Tsaung）是她的助手。
所得情报显示，这些人对最近的谋杀案负责，并且还将实施约30起其他谋杀案，主要针对那些不教授年轻蒋介石（Chiang Kai）（注：原文如此，括号内为汪精卫）主义的学校校长。

自从张八妹到来后，这些人代表日本人行动，独立于李自羣（Lee Shih Chun），李自羣对他们没有控制权。

Station,
REPORT
Date Sept. 5, 1939.
Subject INFORMATION ( CONFIDENTIAL).
Made by D.S.I. Burton Forwarded by
Sir,
Information has been received that three rooms in the Kan Kung (乾公) Primary School, Chinese number 1500 Brenan Road have been taken over by the Lee Shih Chun group and that 30 men are stationed in these rooms. These men are under the control of one named Woo Tsaung (夏超) a henchman of Woo S Pau (吴四宝) and have at their disposal 15 mausers, when these premises were first selected they wished to take over the whole school but in view of the fact that there is about 1000 students in the school, who would not be able to study, they negotiated with the Principal Woo Tsung Wei (吴宗) and took three class rooms
The Tuk Cniu (德记) Gambling Den in East Pah Wha Village which closed down during June this year has also been taken over by this group, 30 men all armed with mausers reside on the premises, these men are all followers of Woo S Pau, who is in charge of them. Some 120 new men of the S.C.G.P.B. which arrived from Peotung on the 3-9-39 were desirous of using these premises as Barracks until other premises were available however they were prevented from doing so by Lee Shih Chun.
Premises No.111 Columbia Road have now been taken over by the Wong Ching Wei (汪精衛) clique and are used as offices some 20 clerks being employed in this capacity under the supervision of one Yang Yoch Sing (楊毓詢).
These premises are guarded by 10 armed men day and night.
D.D.O. WBM Div.
D.S.I.
(批：C.D.O. Sir / Read / C/A / 17/9 / A.H.)

由 侦探副督察伯顿（Burton）呈报 转呈

先生，

据获情报，位于白利南路（Brenan Road）华字1500号的乾公小学（Kan Kung Primary School）内有三间教室已被李士群（Lee Shih Chun）一伙占据，并有30人驻扎于此。这些人受一名叫夏超（Woo Tsaung，音译）的人控制，此人是吴四宝（Woo S Pau）的亲信，他们拥有15支毛瑟枪可供使用。当初选定该处时，他们曾希望占据整个学校，但鉴于校内约有1000名学生，若全被占据将导致学生无法上课，因此他们与校长吴宗（Woo Tsung Wei，音译）协商，仅占用了三间教室。

今年六月关闭的位于东八华村（East Pah Wha Village）的德记赌场（Tuk Cniu Gambling Den，音译）也被该团伙占据，30名均配备毛瑟枪的人员驻守在该处，这些人均为吴四宝的追随者，由吴负责指挥。1939年9月3日从浦东抵达的约120名上海特别市政府警察（S.C.G.P.B.）新人曾希望在这些房屋腾出前将其用作营房，但遭到李士群的阻止。

哥伦比亚路（Columbia Road）111号现已被汪精卫（Wong Ching Wei）派系占据，用作办公场所，在杨毓詢（Yang Yoch Sing，音译）的监督下雇有约20名职员。
该处日夜均有10名武装人员守卫。

“B”分区副督察长 WBM
侦探副督察
（批注：首席侦探督察官 先生 / 已阅 / C/A / 9月17日 / A.H.）

Bubbling Well Station,
REPORT
Date. Aug. 29 1939.
Subject. Information.
Made by D. L. Burton. Forwarded by [Signature]
Sir,
It is reported that premises No. 199 Fung Wah Road,
Pah Tha Village are occupied by one Sung Tsung Mei (沈忠美)
a lieutenant of Lee Shih Chun (李自群), this man has a
following of 30 men who are armed with 40 mausers and have
a number of grenades stored in the premises.
They style themselves the Pah Hwa Kyau Tsah Dai
(巡察隊) "Investigation Corps" and are under the direct
control of Lee Shih Chun, who details them for any special
work he may require carried out.
A country style house in the Loo Sin Zah (錫宅)
Village is occupied by some 150 men all natives of Anhwei,
who are armed with 60 pistols of various types, these
pistols having been obtained by the men themselves from
unknown sources, they are in charge of one named Too Luh
San (胡德山), well known Tau Ka Woo loafer and style
themselves the Tze Wei Dai (自衛隊), "Self Defence Corps"
These men are taught each day by a member of the
Japanese Gendarmerie on military and political subjects,
these men are under Japanese control and not connected with
Lee Shih Chun.
Houses No. 6 & 7, Lane 95 Edinburgh Road are
occupied by some 36 unarmed men who were brought to
Shanghai from Tsungkang, Tsungkong, they are in charge of
one named Sung Ching Meu (沈金茂), who is assisted by
one Bah Dah Loong (白大龍), these men were formerly
guerrillas in their native districts and were driven out
by a stronger band, so took refugee in Shanghai under
Japanese control.

主题 情报。
由 D. L. Burton 呈报 转呈 [签名]

先生，

据报，八打村（Pah Tha Village，音译）丰华路（Fung Wah Road，音译）199号被沈忠美（Sung Tsung Mei，音译）占据，此人是李士群（Lee Shih Chun）的副手。此人手下有30名追随者，配备40支毛瑟枪，并在该处储存了若干手榴弹。
他们自称为“巡察队”（Pah Hwa Kyau Tsah Dai，音译），直接受李士群控制，李士群指派他们执行任何所需的特殊任务。

锡宅村（Loo Sin Zah Village，音译）的一座乡间房屋被约150名安徽籍人士占据，他们配备60支各种类型的手枪，这些手枪是这些人从不明来源自行获取的。他们由一名叫胡德山（Too Luh San，音译）的人负责，此人是知名的土著流氓，他们自称为“自卫队”（Tze Wei Dai，音译）。
这些人每天由一名日本宪兵队员教授军事和政治科目，这些人受日本人控制，与李士群无关。

爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）95弄6号和7号被约36名无武装人员占据，这些人是从崇明（Tsungkang，音译）、崇公（Tsungkong，音译，原文如此，疑为崇明之误或另一地名）带到上海的。他们由一名叫沈金茂（Sung Ching Meu，音译）的人负责，白大龍（Bah Dah Loong，音译）协助他。这些人以前在其家乡地区是游击队员，因被更强大的帮派驱逐，故在上海在日本人的控制下避难。

1939年9月20日下午2时30分，居住在杰斯菲尔德路75号的神智学会（Theosophical Society）会长R. Wright先生来到静安寺巡捕房，该处位于76号对面并可俯瞰76号的场地，他陈述如下：

1939年9月15日中午左右，76号的一名代表拜访了75号，告知中国仆人们他们希望占用该建筑作为办公用途，并要求安排与神智学会的相关负责人会面。基于此请求，学会会长R. Wright先生与76号的代表于9月15日下午4时安排了会面。

此次在杰斯菲尔德路75号举行的会面中，76号有两名代表出席。其中一人似乎是日本人，能流利地说英语和中文，在谈话中担任中方代表的翻译。美国公民、油漆商H.B. Campbell先生以顾问身份代表学会出席。该房屋的承租人是名为A.P. Knudsen的美国公民。

76号的代表开场表示希望租用该建筑。他们被告知该建筑已出租10年，且学会已花费了相当

able amount of money in adopting the premises to its
needs. The representatives of 76 asked for details of
expenditure and were informed that it was about $20,000.
After considerable discussion the representatives of 76
expressed a desire that a detailed list of expenditure
be furnished them. With this end in view a further
meeting was arranged for Friday, Sept. 22, 1939.
The representatives of 76 were informed that the
Society would be unable to vacate the premises for at
least one month, even if requirements for transfer of
lease were successful. In reply the representatives of
76 stated that it was imperative they be given an
opportunity to occupy the premises at a much earlier
date.
The meeting closed pending a detailed list of
expenditure being submitted by the Society to the
representatives of 76, after which further negotiations
for a settlement could be made. In this connection Mr.
Wright has promised to notify me of the results.
In connection with the foregoing report it is of
interest to note that due to the location of 75
Jessfield Road persons entering and leaving are always
regarded with suspicion by members of 76 who frequently
question such persons. At night they often shine a
searchlight onto the windows of 75, evidently for the
purpose of spotting persons who may be spying.

W. Galbraith
Det. Inspector

pages.zh:
-第2页-

可观的资金用于改造该场所以适应其需求。76号的代表询问支出细节，被告知约为20,000美元。经过大量讨论后，76号的代表表示希望提供一份详细的支出清单。为此，双方约定于1939年9月22日（星期五）再次会面。
76号的代表被告知，即使租赁转让手续成功，学会至少也需要一个月才能搬离该场所。作为回应，76号的代表表示，必须让他们有机会更早地占用该场所。
会议暂停，待学会向76号代表提交详细支出清单后，再就解决方案进行进一步谈判。在此方面，Wright先生已承诺向我通报结果。
就上述报告而言，值得注意的是，由于杰斯菲尔德路75号的位置，进出人员总是受到76号成员的怀疑，他们经常盘问此类人员。夜间，他们经常将探照灯照射到75号的窗户上，显然是为了发现可能正在 spying（侦察/窥探）的人员。

W. Galbraith
侦探督察

With reference to the secret pro-Japanese
organization which has its Headquarters established at
76 Jessfield Road, it is learned that the principal of
the organization Ting Ma Tsung recently called several
prominent members of the Chinese underworld who are
residents of the Settlement and French Concession, to a
house connected with and situated at the rear of 1136
Yu Yuen Road.
About ten persons attended who are the governing
members of the notorious Red and Green loafer gangs
known as the Tsing Paung (青幫) and Hoong Paung (紅幫).
These men were told by Ting in plain language
that they were expected to give their support to the
Wang Ching Wei policy and to instruct their followers
to do likewise.
Further, that if their services were needed they
would be told what to do; and that any opposition to the
policy as laid down by Wang Ching Wei would result in
serious consequences to those concerned.

Certified copy.
J. T. Sowell

Further Report re Arrest of Two Chinese Workers
at the Foh Loong Silk Filature, No.957 Kiaochow
Road, O.O.L., by the Chinese Volunteer Corps.

At 8:30 A.M., September 13, 1939., the
two workers of the Foh Loong Silk Filature, No.957
Kiaochow Road, O.O.L., namely, Tseu Tuh Foh (周德福),
and Kwok Siau Mau (郭小毛), who had been arrested at the
above factory by the Chinese Volunteer Corps on 10.9.39.,
came to the Station and reported that they had been
released on 11.9.39.

It appears that they were arrested by the
Special Service Squad of the Chinese Volunteer Corps,
(中華自衛團特務部), stationed at No.1 Kong Ka Jau, off
Jessfield Road, O.O.L., at the request of Ah Sze (阿四),
an ex-worker of the Foh Loong Silk Filature, who accused
them of having been concerned together in stealing his
gold finger ring and other property from his quarters
on the factory premises, whilst he was being employed there

Following their arrest, they were taken
to No.1 Kong Ka Jau, off Jessfield Road, O.O.L., where
they were detained in a ground floor rear room, which is
protected with iron grill gates and gives the appearance
of a prison.

关于中国义勇队逮捕胶州路957号福龙缫丝厂两名华工的后续报告。

1939年9月13日上午8时30分，胶州路957号福龙缫丝厂的两名工人，即周德福 (Tseu Tuh Foh) 和郭小毛 (Kwok Siau Mau)，前来捕房报告。二人曾于1939年9月10日被中国义勇队在上述工厂逮捕，现报告他们已于1939年9月11日获释。

据悉，他们是由驻扎在胶州路旁康家桥1号的中国义勇队特务部 (Special Service Squad of the Chinese Volunteer Corps, 中華自衛團特務部) 逮捕的。此举是应福龙缫丝厂前工人阿四 (Ah Sze) 的请求进行的，阿四指控二人在受雇于该厂期间，共同从其厂区宿舍内窃取了他的金戒指及其他财物。

被捕后，他们被带至胶州路旁康家桥1号，关押在一间底层后屋内。该房间装有铁栅栏门，外观如同监狱。

Following the release of Kwoh Siau Mau, Lieu

back on the morning of September 12, 1939.

Sir,
It is learnt that the houses in Lane 455 (Chinese number), Jessfield Road were taken over by Lee Shih Chun (李士群) on instructions of his immediate chief one named Tseu Poh Hai (周佛海), who is closely connected with Wang Ching Wei, in view of the fact that these houses overlook No.76 Jessfield Road, the Headquarters of Lee Shih Chun, and he suspected that members of the S.M.P. would probably rent upper rooms of these houses, thus be able to check the activities inside the grounds and premises and note all comings and goings.
These houses 15 in all were officially taken over by Lee Shih Chun's group on the morning of 28-)-39 as a meeting had been arranged to take place at No.76 on that date.
In order to allay suspicion, banners were erected in and around the premises and grounds, suggesting a birthday celebration was being held.
The meeting was called to select members for a Government which is to be officially inaugurated on the double tenth, some 200 persons attended consisting of former members of the Chiang Kai Shek's Koumintang Government, former high Military Officers and prominent Wong Ching Wei delegates.
The trend of the meeting was that the new Government should follow the Japanese principles and be staunchly pro-Japanese.
That war between China and Japanese be ended, and the Anti-Japanese policy adopted by Chiang Kai Shek be fought

At 3.40 p.m. 2-7-39 C.I.C. 3021 telephoned to
the station and reported that a shooting affray
was in progress on Edinburgh Road near Ts Yu Fang,
between a S.M.P. Search Party consisting of F.I.S.
83 Cockburn I.C, C.I.C.s 2359, 2364, 2364 and
Female Searcher No.32 and a gang of armed men.

The Station Alarm was rung and a party of
Police under C.I. Dudley, Officer i/c., attended,
but on arrival found that the shooting had ceased.

From enquiries made by D.S. Weeks, D.S.I. Wu
Chen Ho and C.D.S.142, the following facts were
ascertained:-

At about 3.35 p.m. 2-7-39, the Search Party
saw three male Chinese come out of a lane situated
on the West side of Edinburgh Road, about 100
yards South of Yu Yuen Road. This lane leads into
West Ts Yu Fang Village, where a gambling den is
situated.

The party stopped the men and searched them.
They informed the C.I.C.s that they were members
of a Special Section of the S.C.G.P.B. and were
stationed at House No.6, Lane 95, Edinburgh Road.

On being allowed to proceed, the three men
crossed the road and walked into the above lane.

A few minutes later, I.S. Cockburn saw the
men re-appeared at the Mouth of the lane and one
of them, point a pistol at the Search Party in a
very threatening manner.

He ordered the party to take cover, and
whilst C.I.C.2364 and himself took cover in a shop

几分钟后，外籍巡长（I.S.）科伯恩看见这些人再次出现在弄堂口，其中一人以极具威胁的方式用枪指着搜查队。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

I. P. Cockburn, knowing that his party were out-numbered, made no attempt to fire, but kept the men covered.

One of them suddenly fired one shot which lodged in the wall above I. P. Cockburn's head, and then both of them jumped back out of sight.

C. S. 2563 shouted to them to stop firing, to which they replied that they would do so, if the S. M. P. policemen replaced their pistols in their holsters.

At the moment, I. P. Cockburn saw a male Chinese of small stature, dressed in a Sam jacket and khaki short pants, run out of the lane on the west side of the road, into the middle of the roadway, and order the men standing in lane 95 to stop firing.

He then called out in English to I. P. Cockburn and asked him not to fire.

I. P. Cockburn left the shop and walked across the road and stood beside this man, who appeared to have some influence over his attackers.

He then called on the C. I. D. to join him (It will be noted that men were observed to be picking up the cartridge cases from the mouth of lane 95). The man told I. P. Cockburn to follow him and started to walk towards Yu Yuen Road.

我，P. 科克本（I. P. Cockburn），深知我方人数处于劣势，未试图开火，而是用枪指着那些人进行威慑。

其中一人突然开了一枪，子弹嵌在我头顶上方的墙壁里，随后两人跳回隐蔽处，消失在我的视线中。

首席巡长（C. S.）2563号向他们大喊停止射击，他们回答说，如果上海公共租界工部局警务处（S. M. P.）的警员将手枪插回枪套，他们就停止射击。

此时，我，P. 科克本，看见一名身材矮小的中国男子，身穿中山装上衣和卡其色短裤，从路西侧的弄堂跑出来，跑到马路中间，命令站在95弄的人停止射击。

随后他用英语对我，P. 科克本，大喊，要求我不要开火。

我，P. 科克本，离开店铺，穿过马路，站在这名男子身边，他似乎对他的攻击者有一定的影响力。

随后他呼叫刑事侦缉探员（C. I. D.）与他汇合（值得注意的是，有人观察到有人在95弄口捡拾弹壳）。该男子让我，P. 科克本，跟随他，并开始朝愚园路方向走去。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...........

                                Bubbling Well Station,
            REPORT              Date June 2............19 39.

Subject    Re shooting affray on Edinburgh Road.

Made by. F.Po... 63 Cockburn.    Forwarded by....................................................

Sir,

    I beg to report that at about 3.35p.m. 2-7-39,
whilst on search party with C.P.C.s 2364, 2564 and 2989,
and female searcher Zung Zee Sz No. 32 on Edinburgh Road
between Yu Yuen Road and Avenue Haig, I observed three
male Chinese, dressed in civilian clothes, coming out of
a lane situated on the West-side of Edinburgh Road and
about 100 yards South of Yu Yuen Road.

    I ordered the C. P.C.s to search the men, which they
did, and then allowed the men to go. They crossed the
road and walked into Lane 95 Edinburgh Road.

    A few minutes later, I saw one of the men standing
at the mouth of the lane and pointing a pistol at us in
a threatening manner.

    I immediately ordered the search party to take
shelter in shop doors, which they did. As we entered
various shops, some person fired several shots along the
road from the direction of Lane 95 Edinburgh Road. I did
not see who fired these shots. I then shouted to C.P.C.
2564 to telephone the station, and as he was leaving
the shop, where he had taken cover, a uniform S.C.G.P.B.
Policeman, who had joined the three plainclothes men, at
the mouth of Lane 95, lifted his rifle to his shoulder
and fired two or three shots at C.P.C. 2564 as he ran
along Edinburgh Road towards Yu Yuen Road.

    On arriving at Yu Yuen and Edinburgh Roads inter-
section, C.P.C. 2564 found that C.P.C. 3021, off duty,
had learned the shooting and had already informed the
Station by street telephone. He was then joined by C.P.C.
2989 who ran along Edinburgh Road after him.

            报告              日期 1939年6月2日............。

主题    关于爱丁堡路枪击冲突事件。

呈报人. F.Po... 63 科克本（Cockburn）。    转呈人....................................................。

先生，

    谨此报告，1939年7月2日下午约3点35分，
当我与中央巡逻车警员（C.P.C.s）2364号、2564号和2989号，
以及女搜查员宗子氏（Zung Zee Sz）32号在爱丁堡路上、
介于愚园路与海格路（Avenue Haig）之间执行搜查任务时，
我观察到三名身穿便服的中国男子从爱丁堡路西侧、
愚园路以南约100码处的一条弄堂里走出来。

    我命令中央巡逻车警员搜查这些人，他们照办了，
然后放行。这些人穿过马路，走进爱丁堡路95弄。

    几分钟后，我看见其中一人站在弄堂口，
以威胁的方式用枪指着我们。

    我立即命令搜查队躲进店门内，他们照做了。
当我们进入各家店铺时，有人从爱丁堡路95弄方向
沿路开了几枪。我没看见是谁开的枪。随后我向中央巡逻车警员
2564号大喊，让他打电话给警署，当他离开
藏身的店铺时，一名已加入三名便衣警察行列的
身穿制服的上海公共租界工部局警务处特别巡捕房（S.C.G.P.B.）警员，
在95弄口举起步枪抵肩，
向沿爱丁堡路朝愚园路方向奔跑的中央巡逻车警员2564号
开了两到三枪。

    到达愚园路与爱丁堡路交叉口时，中央巡逻车警员
2564号发现休班的中央巡逻车警员3021号已得知枪击事件，
并已通过街头电话通知了警署。随后，沿爱丁堡路追在他身后的
中央巡逻车警员2989号也与他汇合。

REPORT
Date June 2 19 39.
Subject Continued.
Made by. F.P. . 83 Cockburn. Forwarded by....................................................

C.P.C. 2364 and myself, who meanwhile had taken
cover in a shop No. 508 Edinburgh Road, were suddenly
surprised by two other plainclothes Chinese, both armed
with mausers, who had worked their way through various
lanes to the rear of the shop, and who ordered us to
drop our pistols.
Realizing that we were out numbered, I did not
open fire, but only kept the men covered.
One of them then fired one shot, which went over my
head and lodged in the wall of the shop. Both of them then
jumped back out of my sight.
C.P.C. 2364 shouted to them to stop firing. At
this point a male Chinese of small stature dressed in
a light fown jacket and khaki shorts, ran out of the lane
on the west side of the road, and ordered our attackers
to stop firing. He then shouted to me in English and
asked me not to fire.
I came out of the shop and stood at his side, and
called to the C.P.C. to come up and stand beside me.
The man then told me to walk together with him
towards Yu Yuen Road.
After he had taken us about 50 yards along the
road, I asked him if he would accompany me to the Station.
He refused, and leaving us, he walked back in the
direction of Lane 95 Edinburgh Road.
The C.P.C. and myself continued toward Yu Yuen Road,
and waited at the corner of Yu Yuen and Edinburgh Roads
for the party from the Station, who arrived about two
minutes later.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
F.P.S. 83.

中央巡逻车警员2364号和我本人，当时正躲在爱丁堡路508号的一家店铺内，
突然被另外两名中国便衣男子惊住，这两人均持有毛瑟手枪，
他们穿过各条弄堂绕到店铺后方，命令我们放下手枪。
意识到我们人数处于劣势，我没有开火，只是用枪指着那些人进行威慑。
随后其中一人开了一枪，子弹从我头顶飞过，嵌在店铺的墙壁里。
然后两人都跳回隐蔽处，消失在我的视线中。
中央巡逻车警员2364号向他们大喊停止射击。
此时，一名身材矮小、身穿浅棕色夹克和卡其色短裤的中国男子，
从路西侧的弄堂跑出来，命令我们的攻击者停止射击。
随后他用英语向我大喊，要求我不要开火。
我走出店铺，站在他身边，
并呼叫中央巡逻车警员上来站在我身边。
随后该男子让我和他一起朝愚园路方向走。
他带我们沿路走了大约50码后，
我问他是否愿意陪同我去警署。
他拒绝了，离开我们，朝爱丁堡路95弄的方向走回去。
中央巡逻车警员和我本人继续朝愚园路方向前进，
并在愚园路与爱丁堡路拐角处等待来自警署的队伍，
该队伍大约两分钟后到达。
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
F.P.S. 83。

1.

全一色队（ALL ONE COLOUR CORPS）成员的非法活动。

1939年7月18日上午11点30分，一名名叫符张氏（Woo Tsang Sz）的女子，
45岁，居住于愚园路369号，来到警署报案，称其丈夫符增康（Woo Zung Kong），
60岁，宁波籍，被3名身穿便服的中国男子和1名日本人
从上述地址带走，乘坐一辆黑色私人机动车（车牌号不详）
沿愚园路向西驶离。

经本人会同侦探副督察姚元龙（Yao Yuen Loong）及刑事侦缉队长（C.D.C.）179号调查，查明如下情况：-
同日早上约10点，4名男子进入愚园路369号光华（Kwang Woo）煤砖店，
要求见店主，被告知店主不在，于是他们坐在店里等待，
大约10分钟后，他们上楼寻找店主，因未找到，
便回到楼下，坐下继续等待。

探员前往上述处所并在附近进行了查访，但未能找到任何目睹吴被带走的人。吴的儿子符海富（Woo Hai Foh），26 岁，在探员来访时正在店内，他是其父被带走后返回的。探员就其是否知晓此事对他进行了讯问，但他未能提供任何线索。

在问及生意出售一事时，他陈述称，经其父同意，他与一名由朋友陆志祥（Loh Tsz Ziang）介绍的、居住在杰斯菲尔德路（Jessfield Road）5 号百乐门商场（Paramount Emporium）53 号的华籍男子杨（楊）洽谈出售生意事宜；1939 年 7 月 15 日，杨来到店里并向他支付了 100.00 美元定金（支付这笔钱时其父不在场），并约定于 1939 年 7 月 16 日起草协议。然而，1939 年 7 月 15 日晚，其父决定不出售该生意，于是他打电话给杨

1939 年 7 月 18 日下午 4 时 30 分，吴子宗（Woo Tseu Tsung）在罗子祥（Loh Tsz Ziang）陪同下前往爱丁堡路 35 号，在那里按杨的要求向其支付了 220.00 美元，随后杨获准离开。

吴宗孔（Woo Zung Kong）称，他未受到任何虐待或恐吓，但因经受此番折磨后感到疲惫，请求准予退下；鉴于其年事已高，故未对其加以盘问，而是准许其回家。更多细节将于 1939 年 7 月 19 日从他那里获取。

其妻认为日本人参与了劫走吴某一事，这是一种误解，因为所有四名人员均为中国男性；在愚园路 369 号期间，未见任何人持有武器。

ARREST OF C.D.C. 279 BY ARMED MEMBERS
OF TIH SUH CHUNG (鐵血軍).
========================================

For the purpose of verifying an address given by
a suspect in a larceny case brought to the Bubbling Well
Station by C.P.C. 1385 at 6.15 a.m. June 22, 1939.
C.D.C.279 was despatched by D.S. 252 Weeks to Lane 1423,
House 5, Yu Yuen Road.

The C.D.C. proceeded by station car and alighted
at the entrance to the alleyway. He was looking for
the number of the alleyway standing on the Yu Yuen Road
footpath when two male Chinese, who were standing at the
entrance to the alleyway suddenly threatened him with
mauser pistols. The detective thinking they were
highway robbers offered them money. The suspected
robbers pulled the detective into the alleyway and there
searched him and upon finding that he was armed accused
him of being a traitor. At this juncture the two
suspects were re-enforced by about 20 other armed men.
The C.D.C. was subjected to interrogation and then
marched away to a Chinese style house in the Zau Ka Yi
village situated between Edinburgh and Great Western
Roads.

At 8.05 a.m. June 22, Inspector Yee Kyin Kwei
received a telephone message from Lee Shih Chung (李自群)
living at Lane 95, House 10 Edinburgh Road, C.C.L.

铁血军武装成员逮捕便衣侦探第279号。
========================================

为了核实一名盗窃案嫌疑人在1939年6月22日上午6时15分向静安寺捕房提供的地址，该案由中央捕房警员第1385号移送。便衣侦探第279号由巡官第252号威克斯（Weeks）派往愚园路1423弄5号。

该便衣侦探乘坐警车前往，并在弄堂入口处下车。当他站在愚园路人行道上寻找弄堂号码时，两名站在弄堂入口处的中国男子突然用毛瑟手枪威胁他。该侦探以为他们是拦路抢劫的匪徒，便向他们交出钱财。疑似劫匪将该侦探拉入弄堂内并进行搜身，发现其携带武器后，指控他为汉奸。此时，另有约20名武装男子前来增援这两名嫌疑人。该便衣侦探受到审问，随后被押往位于爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）和大西路（Great Western Road）之间的曹家义村（Zau Ka Yi village）的一处中式房屋。

1939年6月22日上午8时05分，伊金贵（Yee Kyin Kwei）巡长接到居住在爱丁堡路95弄10号的李自群（Lee Shih Chung）打来的电话留言，中央捕房警员。

pages.en:
Misc.No.335/39.
1/2.

informing the Inspector that a detective attached to
Bubbling Well Station had been arrested by a gang of men
and he would effect the release of the detective as a
mistake had been made.
In consequence of this message D.I. Fabrum, Insp.
Yao Kyu, Kwei and D.S. Weeks promptly proceeded to Lane
95, House 10 Edinburgh Road.
Upon arrival at the Lane leading to this house,
the Police party noticed several armed men standing in
the alleyway. Evidently the Police party were expected
as the iron door leading to the compound of the house
was promptly opened to admit them.
Upon entering the compound, the Police were confron-
ted by about 30 men all armed with mauser pistols. The
gate-keeper was armed with a mauser fitted with an
automatic stock.
The Police party were escorted to a large room on
the ground-floor. They were received in a very friendly
manner by Lee Shih Chung who introduced the 10 or 12
men present, some of whom were armed. Included in those
introduced were Sung Tsong Mei (沈忠美), Zee Wen Can
(徐文安), a Mr. Chu and one named Lee Yin Fei (李飛).
The last named, according to information of Bubbling
Well detectives was shot by Inspector Dudley and D.S.I.
Filten when participating in an Armed Robbery at No.8
pages.zh:
杂项编号 335/39。
1/2.

通知督察，一名隶属于静安寺捕房的侦探被一伙人逮捕，他将安排释放该侦探，因为这是一次误会。
鉴于此消息，副督察法布伦（Fabrum）、姚举（Yao Kyu）督察、桂（Kwei）以及警佐威克斯（Weeks）迅速前往爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）95弄10号。
抵达通往该房屋的弄堂时，警方人员注意到巷内有几名持枪男子站立。显然警方人员的到来已在预期之中，因为通往该房屋院落的铁门随即打开让他们进入。
进入院落之后，警方遭遇了约30名全部配备毛瑟手枪的男子。门卫配备有一支装有自动枪托的毛瑟手枪。
警方人员被护送至一楼的一间大房间。李世忠（Lee Shih Chung）以非常友好的态度接待了他们，并介绍了在场的10至12人，其中部分人携带武器。被介绍的人中包括沈忠美（Sung Tsong Mei）、徐文安（Zee Wen Can）、一位朱先生（Mr. Chu）以及一名叫李飞（Lee Yin Fei）的人。据静安寺捕房侦探的情报，最后提到的这名李飞曾在洛克希尔路（Rockhill Avenue）范华兴总店8号参与武装抢劫时被达德利（Dudley）督察和副督察菲尔滕（Filten）开枪击中，

pages.en:
Misc.No. 335/39.

1/3.

Fan Wah Sing Tsung off Rockhill Avenue, Misc.No. 297/39
(BW) and later removed to Lane 95, House 10 Edinburgh
Road in Lee Shih Chung's M/car. During the discussion
Lee Yih Fei openly admitted being shot three times
and showed the Police the scars on his body resulting
from the bullet wounds he received. He was shot twice
in the back and once in the buttocks.

    Lee Shih Chung who was previously unknown to any
of the visiting Police is a man of small stature, aged
about 35/6. He claims to be the owner of a steamship
line and also the owner of a Native Bank on Kiukiang
Road. He is a loquacious talker and desires to give
the impression that he is a man of great power. In
response to many questions concerning himself and the
numerous armed men surrounding him, he stated in
principle, that he had was a man of such power that he
was not subject either to the rule of the Japanese
or members of the Shanghai City Government. He had
under him between 700 or 800 men, most of whom, he
stated had been recruited from the villages in the
Western Area of Shanghai. This organization, he
called the Tih Suh Chung (Iron Colour Corps) (鐵血軍)
50 of whom act as bodyguards to himself.
pages.zh:
杂项编号 335/39。

1/3.

（接上页）随后由李世忠用其私家车转移至爱丁堡路95弄10号。在交谈过程中，李飞公开承认曾三次中弹，并向警方展示了子弹伤口在他身上留下的疤痕。他背部中了两枪，臀部中了一枪。

    李世忠此前不为任何来访警方人员所知，身材矮小，年龄约35或36岁。他声称自己拥有一家轮船公司，同时也是九江路一家华商银行的业主。他健谈，且希望给人留下拥有巨大权势的印象。在回答许多关于他自己及其周围众多武装人员的问题时，他原则上表示，他的权势之大，以至于既不受日本人统治，也不受上海市政府成员的管辖。他手下有700至800人，他称这些人大多招募自上海西部地区的村庄。他将此组织称为“铁血军”（Tih Suh Chung），其中有50人担任他的保镖。

pages.en:
"B"
Misc.No.335/39.
1/4.

Questioned as to the expenses for the upkeep of
this organization, Lee stated they are at present
poorly supported but when they need funds he provides
them.
The object of this organization, Lee stated, is
to eliminate members of pro-Chinese assassination
groups. Lee even went so far as to say that C.D.C.279 would
have been executed if it had not have been for the
fact that he was able to establish his identity by virtue
of the fact that he had a S.M.P. Warrant Card and S.M.P.
pistol and was later proved to be a member of the S.M.P.
Lee proposed that his organization be accorded
friendly treatment by detectives at Bubbling Well
Station with whom he expressed a desire to co-operate
for the specific purpose of exterminating members of
pro-Chinese assassination groups. He further stated
that as Police at Bubbling Well Station were responsible
for law and order in territory under the jurisdiction
of the S.M.C. in the Western Area that he be afforded
all possible protection.
Lee concluded the discussion which had lasted more
than one hour by stating that within a month or two
from now Mr. Wang Ching Wei would probably come to
Shanghai and there would be peace and quietness in the
Western Area of Shanghai.
pages.zh:
"B"
杂项编号 335/39。
1/4.

当被问及维持该组织的费用时，李表示目前支持匮乏，但当他们需要资金时，他会提供。
李称，该组织的目的是清除亲华暗杀团体的成员。李甚至进一步表示，如果不是因为他能够凭借持有工部局警务处（S.M.P.）委任证和工部局警务处手枪来确立身份，并且后来被证实为工部局警务处成员的话，代号为 C.D.C.279 的侦探早就被处决了。
李提议，静安寺捕房的侦探应对其组织给予友好对待，他表示希望与静安寺捕房合作，专门旨在消灭亲华暗杀团体的成员。他还表示，由于静安寺捕房的警察负责维护工部局（S.M.C.）在上海西部地区管辖范围内的法律与秩序，因此他应获得一切可能的保护。
李结束了持续一个多小时的谈话，他表示在一两个月内，汪精卫先生可能会来到上海，上海西部地区将会恢复和平与安宁。

pages.en:
Misc.No.335/39.
1/8.

During the discussion Sergeant Major Shida
entered the room, he was greeted in a friendly manner
by all. He left after a few minutes, not knowing the
reason for presence of the S.M.P. Lee stated as he was
not obliged to tell Sergeant Major Shida, whom he would
not inform of the incident.

Some of the men the Police saw and were introduced
to at Lee's residence were students between 20 and 25
years of age. Others were of the robber and loafer type.

The C.D.C. was handed over to D.I. Tabrum together
with his pistol and Warrant Card at about 10.15a.m.
With the exception of being scared the detective had
not been injured in anyway.

After returning to the Station, Inspector
Yamaguchi approached D.I. Tabrum and asked if there had
been any trouble at Lane 95, House 10 Edinburgh Road.
He explained that Sergeant Major Shida had just phoned
for information and stated that to approach this
particular house was very dangerous and, that he had
received instructions from a high authority to cause
the arrest of all unauthorized persons found in the
vicinity thereof.

Inspector Yamaguchi was told that Police went on
a friendly visit at the request of Lee Shih Chung.

D. I. Tabrum
Det. Inspector.
pages.zh:
杂项编号 335/39。
1/8.

在交谈期间，志田（Shida）巡佐进入房间，所有人都友好地向他致意。几分钟后他离开了，并不知晓工部局警务处人员在场的原因。李表示，他没有义务告诉志田巡佐，因此不会将此事告知他。

警方在李的住所见到并被介绍认识的人中，部分是年龄在20至25岁之间的学生。其他人则属于流氓和无业游民类型。

上午10点15分左右，代号 C.D.C. 的侦探连同其手枪和委任证一起被移交给副督察塔布拉姆（Tabrum）。除受到惊吓外，该侦探未受任何伤害。

返回捕房后，山口（Yamaguchi）督察走近副督察塔布拉姆，询问在爱丁堡路95弄10号是否发生了任何麻烦。他解释说，志田巡佐刚刚打电话来询问情况，并表示接近这所特定的房屋非常危险，而且他已收到高层当局的指示，要逮捕在该区域附近发现的所有未经授权的人员。

山口督察被告知，警方是应李世忠的请求进行友好访问的。

副督察 塔布拉姆
侦探督察

have been thoroughly questioned and statements taken
from each person but no proof has been obtained to con-
nect them with the shooting which forms the subject of
this F.I.R. The statements prove that the accused
are loafers attached to the Gambling Dens in the
Western Area and apparently live by means of extortion
and under the protection of the Japanese Sponsored
Reform Government and Wang Ching-wei parties.

Owing to the fact that the Police cannot
connect the accused with any criminal case inside
the Settlement a request is made that the Writ of
Detention against them be withdrawn and the men
released.

目前我在罗便臣路614号的上海木材厂担任私人侦探。
    三个月前，通过国泰烟馆（Kuo Tai Opium Den）老板邹家杜（Zau Ka Doo，音译）的介绍，我结识了现已故的杨清海（Yang Ching Hai）。
    由于上海木材厂的员工经常发生骚乱，因此不时请求杨清海提供协助。
    1939年11月7日，我拜访了位于极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）旁永禄增（Yung Loh Tseng，音译）4号的陆志平（Loo Ts Ping，音译）家，当时遇到了杨清海，他让我于1939年11月9日晚上7点在福州路的万利酒楼（Van Lee Restaurant）23号房间见他。
    因此，在约定的时间和日期，我前往上述酒楼，发现杨清海和大约30人在场。随后我们在房间内分桌用餐，大约30分钟后，当晚宴仍在进行时，我听到连续的枪声。我趴在地上，所以没有看到开枪的人。

Louza Stn.        9-11-39             translated //////// Clerk Sih Yun Pai.

I am a cloth-weaver by profession. I reside at
No.199 Sze Ming Tseng, Zikawei.

One of my fellow countrymen named Lee Kya Yoong
was an employee of a gambling den located at the Western
Area of Shanghai. As my business - cloth weaving - was
bad, I requested Lee Kya Yoong to find a better job for
me. Lee promised, but stated that I should first have a
"Lou Der Ts", so that I could find a job very easy. He
suggested that I be a follower to Yang (now deceased), who

i.e. to request Yang to be my "Lou Der Ts"..

我是一名织布工。我居住在徐家汇思明曾（Sze Ming Tseng，音译）199号。

我的一位同乡李加荣（Lee Kya Yoong，音译）是上海西区一家赌窟的员工。由于我的生意——织布——不景气，我请求李加荣为我找一份更好的工作。李答应了，但说我应该先拜一位“老头子”（Lou Der Ts，音译），这样找工作就很容易。他建议我追随杨（现已故），杨是日本人的下属官员，在上海西区很有名。他还补充说，不久将在该地区开设一家赌窟，并将雇佣70-80人。因此，我打算按照李的建议行事，即请求杨做我的“老头子”。

今晚（1939年11月9日），我参加了在万利酒楼举行的宴会，当我们用餐时听到枪声，我立即躲到桌子底下。后来我被警察带到警局。

    At about 8.a.m. on the 8-11-39, I received an

Foochow, where upon arrival I found about 40 persons present.
    At the time the dinner party was taking place, I
and Yang Ching Hai (the deceased) sat at the same table.
About 5 minutes later, I heard someone opening fire at
Loo Ts Ping from my right side. I immediately lay down
on the floor, and heard the sound of successive gunshots
being fired. Five minutes later, I got up and found/both that
Yang Ching Hai and Loo Ts Ping had been seriously wounded,

    我想在上海西区的一家赌窟找份工作，所以我找到了一位在同乡赌窟工作的同乡李加荣，请求他为我找一份同样的工作。
    李加荣建议我拜杨（现已故）为“老头子”，杨是日本人的下属官员，在上海西区很有名，得到他的帮助，我就能很容易地在赌窟找到工作。
    因此，我决定采纳李加荣的建议，并安排今晚（1939年11月9日）在福州路514号的万利酒楼见杨（现已故），那里正在举行晚宴。
    在我们用餐时，我听到枪声，因受惊吓摔倒在地。此后我一无所知。

16 10 40

Wang's "Merry Men"
Special Police
Make Debut In
Green Uniform

Causing a mild flurry of uneasiness at their first appearance, when residents feared that they might function in the Western area, nearly 1,300 recruits of the Nanking Government's special police donned their new green uniforms for the first time yesterday, after undergoing a period of training at the Hollywood Gardens on Yu Yuen Road, former gambling den closed down a few months ago by order of the Shanghai Special Municipality.

The International Settlement authorities are stated to be aware of the existence of the new police body, and it is understood that a tacit agreement exists whereby the new unit will not make use of the Settlement roads.

The actual duties of the special unit could not be ascertained, but it is understood that they have been undergoing intensive training during the past few months, during which time they wore plain clothes, only appearing in uniform yesterday.

身着绿制服
首次亮相

南京政府特种警察的近1300名新兵昨日首次穿上新的绿色制服，此前他们在愚园路的好莱坞花园（Hollywood Gardens，一家数月前奉上海特别市当局命令关闭的前赌馆）接受了一段时间的训练。在他们首次亮相时，引起了居民轻微的恐慌不安，因为居民担心他们可能会在西区执行职务。

据称，公共租界当局知晓这支新警察部队的存在，且据悉双方存在一项默契协议，即该新部队不会使用租界内的道路。

该特种部队的具体职责尚无法查明，但据悉他们在过去几个月中一直进行强化训练，在此期间他们身着便衣，直到昨日才身穿制服出现。

MAR 6 1940
9236
26 4 40

A Test Case
THE local organ of Japanese opinion, the Shanghai Mainichi, can usually be trusted to put its feet into it, if there is the slightest opportunity for so doing. The latest example of the penchant followed the arrest by a detachment of the British Defense Force, of a party of Chinese gun-men, in a lane off Crescent Alley, inside the British Defense Sector. The British troops stopped and searched a couple of suspicious looking Chinese, and found that both of them were armed with Mauser pistols. They then surrounded the headquarters of the gang, and called upon the inmates to surrender. Eleven men came out, and a search of the premises led to the seizure of seven more pistols. After this coup Japanese Gendarmes appeared on the scene, and demanded that the seized weapons should be handed over to them. This demand was rejected by the British Military authorities, who intimated that the men and their weapons would only be released when they had been identified by some responsible organization, and their presence, armed, in the British Sector was satisfactorily explained.

The significance of the Japanese demand for the handing over of the nine pistols became apparent a few days later. But in the interval the Shanghai Mainichi put both feet into it by printing an article attacking the British troops for "unruly conduct" in arresting and detaining "20 Chinese workers of Mr. Wang Ching-wei's organization." Such "outrageous acts" required the punishment of the "British Tommies," and were especially to be deplored, following as they did upon the signature of an agreement for the policing of the Western Roads area.

THE admission that the men arrested by the British troops were "workers of Mr. Wang Ching-wei's organization" is likely to have most embarrassing consequences for the Japanese authorities, especially their Gendarmerie and Special Service Section. It has repeatedly been alleged by the Municipal Police and as frequently denied by the Japanese military, that most of the outrages committed within the Settlement during the past few months by pro-Japanese Gangsters, were perpetrated by proteges of Mr. Wang Ching-wei and the Special Service Section. If the demand of the Japanese Gendarmerie in this instance had been complied with the evidence connecting Mr. Wang Ching-wei's workers with these crimes would certainly have vanished. Fortunately, the British military retained the weapons, and placed them at the disposal of the Ballistics experts of the S. M. Police for investigation.

Now the science of identifying fire-arms has attained such perfection, that given empty cartridge cases, or a not too deformed bullet, the weapon from which it has been fired can be identified with the same certainty as a finger-print record. As the result of the "unruly conduct" of the British Tommies, this is what the Police discovered:

Among the weapons seized were three pistols which were used in the murderous attack upon the offices of the China Evening News on the evening of July 22, 1939, during which an American citizen, Mr. "Tug" Wilson was murdered; they also included the pistols used in an affray at the Asia Club, 65, Gordon Road, on September 11, 1938; in a battle with the S. M. Police in Sinza Road on July 21, 1939; in the murder of a Chinese Constable and the wounding of a Sikh at the traffic control at the corner of Yu Yuen and Edinburgh Roads on October 10, 1939; in an armed robbery in Robison Road on June 20, 1939; in an outrage on the premises of the University Press in Ningpo Road on June 17, 1939; in armed robberies in Singapore Road in June 1939; in an attack upon a mounted Sikh Patrol on Jessfield Road on June 15, 1939; in another armed robbery in Taku Road on May 23, 1939; and finally in a murderous attack upon two Sikh Police in Jessfield Road on June 27, 1939. It would appear, then that these "workers of Mr. Wang Ching-wei's organization" are in fact a gang of armed desperadoes, some of whom at least merit the death sentence, and others long terms of imprisonment.

IT will be interesting to see what attitude is taken by the Japanese Military authorities, now that the connection between these men, and a long series of armed outrages, including several murders, has been definitely established. Will they cooperate in seeing that the men are brought to trial, and punished as they deserve, or will they—as has occurred on previous occasions—demand that they be handed over in order that they may be permitted to escape? It seems to be a test case. The evidence of the S.M.P. Ballistic experts is conclusive. The onus of proving that they did not use the weapons found in their possession for the crimes committed with them, rests squarely upon the shoulders of the arrested men. It would be asking us to stretch our imagination beyond breaking point to believe that the pistols came into their possession innocently, after all these outrages had been perpetrated. The Shanghai Mainichi's angry diatribe against the British troops, however, has placed the Japanese in a most embarrassing position. It appears to make it necessary for them, if they value their prestige, definitely to repudiate any connection between the arrested men and Mr. Wang's organization. It must be regarded as out of the question for the Japanese military to extend their protection to a gang of armed desperadoes with such an appalling record. Obviously, their best course would be to cooperate with the S.M.Police in seeing that these men get their just deserts. The possibility of treating them as the injured victims of the "unruly conduct" of "British Tommies" vanished when the latter refused to part with the seized weapons except to the Ballistic experts of the S. M. Police.

一个测试案例
日本舆论的地方喉舌《上海每日新闻》（Shanghai Mainichi），只要稍有可乘之机，通常总会自找麻烦。最近的一个例子是，在英国防区内的新月里（Crescent Alley）旁的一条弄堂里，英国防卫部队的一支分队逮捕了一伙中国枪手。英军拦下并搜查了两名形迹可疑的中国人，发现两人都携带毛瑟手枪。随后，英军包围了该帮派的总部，并要求屋内人员投降。十一人走了出来，对场所的搜查又缴获了七支手枪。在这次突击行动之后，日本宪兵出现在现场，要求将缴获的武器移交给他们。这一要求被英国军事当局拒绝，后者表示，只有在某个负责任的组织对这些人的身份进行确认，并对他们携带武器出现在英国防区的行为作出令人满意的解释后，才会释放这些人及其武器。

几天后，日本方面要求移交九支手枪的用意变得明显起来。但在此期间，《上海每日新闻》通过刊登一篇文章，再次自找麻烦，该文章指责英军在逮捕和拘留“汪精卫先生的组织的20名中国工人”时行为“不端”。这种“暴行”需要惩罚“英国大兵”，尤其令人痛惜的是，这些行为发生在签署关于西区道路区域警务管理的协议之后。

承认被英军逮捕的人员是“汪精卫先生的组织的工人”，这可能会给日本当局，特别是其宪兵队和特务部，带来极为尴尬的后果。工部局警务处曾多次指控，而日军则同样频繁地否认，过去几个月在租界内由亲日帮派分子犯下的大多数暴行，是由汪精卫先生和特务部的门徒所为。如果此次日本宪兵的要求得到满足，那么将汪精卫的手下与这些罪行联系起来的证据无疑将会消失。幸运的是，英军保留了这些武器，并将其交由工部局警务处的弹道专家进行调查。

如今，枪支识别科学已达到如此完美的程度，只要有空弹壳或一枚变形不太严重的子弹，就能像指纹记录一样确定地识别出发射该子弹的武器。由于“英国大兵”的“不端行为”，警方发现了以下情况：

在缴获的武器中，有三支手枪曾用于1939年7月22日晚对《中国晚报》（China Evening News）办事处的谋杀袭击，当时美国公民“塔格”·威尔逊（"Tug" Wilson）先生遇害；其中包括1938年9月11日在戈登路65号亚洲俱乐部（Asia Club）的一场斗殴中使用的手枪；1939年7月21日在新闸路（Sinza Road）与工部局警务处发生冲突时使用的手枪；1939年10月10日在愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）和爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）拐角的交通岗哨上杀害一名华捕并打伤一名锡克警员时使用的手枪；1939年6月20日在罗宾森路（Robison Road）的一次武装抢劫中使用的手枪；1939年6月17日在宁波路商务印书馆（University Press） premises 发生的一起暴行中使用的手枪；1939年6月在新加坡路（Singapore Road）的武装抢劫中使用的手枪；1939年6月15日在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）袭击一支锡克骑警队时使用的手枪；1939年5月23日在大沽路（Taku Road）的另一起武装抢劫中使用的手枪；以及最后，1939年6月27日在极司菲尔路谋杀两名锡克警察时使用的手枪。由此可见，这些“汪精卫先生的组织的工人”实际上是一伙武装亡命之徒，其中至少有些人罪当处死，其他人也应判处长期监禁。

现在，既然这些人与一系列包括多起谋杀案在内的武装暴行之间的关联已确凿确立，看看日本军事当局采取何种态度将是很有趣的。他们会合作确保这些人受到审判并得到应有的惩罚吗？还是会像以前发生过的那样，要求移交这些人以便让他们逃脱？这似乎是一个测试案例。工部局警务处弹道专家的证据是确凿的。证明他们没有使用在其 possession 中发现的武器实施相关罪行的责任，完全落在被捕者肩上。要我们相信在这些暴行发生后，这些手枪是清白地落入他们手中的，那简直是强人所难，超出了想象力的极限。然而，《上海每日新闻》对英军的愤怒抨击，使日本人处于极其尴尬的境地。如果他们重视自己的声望，这似乎使他们有必要明确否认被捕者与汪氏组织有任何关联。日本军方为这样一伙有着可怕记录的武装亡命之徒提供保护，必须被视为是不可能的。显然，他们最好的做法是与工部局警务处合作，确保这些人得到应有的惩罚。当英军拒绝将缴获的武器交给除工部局警务处弹道专家以外的任何人时，将他们视为“英国大兵”“不端行为”的受害者的可能性就消失了。
